# Virgil Solis ornament prints

An animal frieze and a bird frieze from Virgil Solis's 1557 series "Mancherlei Conterfectisches von Thierlein" in the Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg, and an arabesque cartouche on dark ground in the Metropolitan Museum of Art; loose prints by one Nuremberg artist, grouped by sheet.

Part of [Ducktape Assets](https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets). Set id `solis-prints`, historical, 3 assets.

## Licence and attribution

Artwork: **LicenseRef-PDM** ([text](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/)). The Hamburg sheets carry the Public Domain Mark; the Metropolitan Museum sheet is CC0 and says so on the asset. See SOURCES.md.
